description: Returns Fill My Bracket's Cinderella radar, as of Sunday, November 1, 2026, exactly as published on the site's rankings page: the unranked teams the model rates far above their poll votes (each with its league, AP votes, model rank, and a plain why line), the Cinderella watch list, and the ranked teams flagged as vulnerable favorites on their projected seed lines, each with that line's counted first-round record from 1985-2025. These are November signals from the preseason poll and one model, stated as the site states them: not predictions, not odds, and no guarantee any of these teams makes the 2027 field, which is set on Selection Sunday, March 14, 2027.
name: get_cinderella_radar
title: Get the Cinderella radar
